name: okf-wiki
description: Inspect, author, validate, and safely refactor file-based Open Knowledge Format wikis with the okf CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Open Knowledge Format wikis safely.
interface.longDescription: Use the okf CLI to discover concepts, maintain metadata and provenance, audit links and citations, and move concepts with recoverable reference updates.
defaultPrompt: Find concepts related to this topic in the OKF wiki.
Create or update an OKF concept and validate it.
Audit this OKF bundle for links, citations, and stale content.
